description.value: The Lion Inn & Suites is an all-suite property in Chetwynd, BC, offering 19 independently appointed suites with full kitchenettes, hardwood flooring, custom tile, and keyless entry doors. Situated at the junction of Highways 97 and 29 — BC's gateway to the Peace River Country — it is a natural overnight stop for cycle tourers traversing this corridor. The property features 24/7 staffed reception and a camera-monitored, well-lit parking area, with the town's amenities reachable entirely on foot.

enrichment_extras.reasoning: The website content from thelionsuite.com is fully fetched and corroborates the OSM record. The About page explicitly confirms coin-operated laundry and complimentary Wi-Fi; the front page explicitly confirms two grocery stores are within walking distance and mentions The Red Lion restaurant nearby. No mention of bike-specific storage or procedures anywhere on the site; the 'secure' parking references apply to vehicle parking monitored by cameras, not dedicated bike storage.
concerns: Privacy policy page references 'thelionsuite.ca' as the canonical domain, while the live site and OSM URL both use 'thelionsuite.com' — possible older domain or minor inconsistency, does not affect listing.
Website copyright footer reads 2015, suggesting the site has not been updated recently; amenity details may be stale.
enrichment_extras.recommended_status_reason: Real, operating hotel in a key cycling corridor town (Hwy 97/29 junction) with active website, online reservations, and confirmed amenities useful to touring cyclists.

Laundry.detail: Website About page: 'coin operated laundry machines' on site

Nearby evening food.detail: Website front page mentions multiple restaurants walkable from the property, including The Red Lion with a full dinner menu

Nearby grocery.detail: Website front page: 'you can walk from our establishment to anywhere in town including the 2 grocery stores.'
